name: lurkwire
description: AI-native security browser with a built-in intercepting proxy

scripts.dev: npm run build:proxy:debug && npm run dev -w @lurkwire/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:proxy && npm run build -w @lurkwire/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:proxy && npm run test -w @lurkwire/desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:proxy && npm run build -w @lurkwire/desktop && npm run dist:linux -w @lurkwire/desktop
scripts.smoke: npm run build:proxy:debug && npm run build -w @lurkwire/desktop && npm run smoke -w @lurkwire/desktop
